subject: RP11 Q11 difficulty flag — x=216 fractional exponent, Marcus aware
body:
GI — RP11 code review complete. One item flagging to the group.

Q11: 3x^(2/3)-4=104, answer x=216.

The path: 3x^(2/3)=108 → x^(2/3)=36 → x=36^(3/2)=(sqrt(36))^3=6^3=216.

This is the hardest fractional exponent we have shipped. Your RP11 data spec (docs/gi-rp11-data-spec.md) focused on W2.d coverage for Q14, which is satisfied. Q11 is W3.b. No schema or coverage issues. Flagging for data completeness — if Kai misses Q11 on the real exam, your W3.b coverage tracking should flag it as a genuine difficulty gap, not a data or schema problem.

- GA
